title: For the top 10 port statuses (by number of ports) among ports with VIF type
question: For the top 10 port statuses (by number of ports) among ports with VIF type 'ovs' and device_id 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7', report each status along with its total ports, minimum admin_state_up, average standard_attr_id, and the maximum (across networks) per-network range of port security bindings per port for that same status considering only ports in tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' that have at least one port security binding. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base_ports AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.status, p.admin_state_up, p.standard_attr_id, p.network_id, p.tenant_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN ml2_port_bindings mpb ON p.id = mpb.port_id
  WHERE p.device_id = 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7'
    AND mpb.vif_type = 'ovs'
),
status_counts AS (
  SELECT status, COUNT(id) AS total_ports
  FROM base_ports
  GROUP BY status
  ORDER BY total_ports DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
status_measures AS (
  SELECT 
    bp.status,
    COUNT(bp.id) AS total_ports,
    MIN(bp.admin_state_up) AS min_admin_state_up,
    AVG(bp.standard_attr_id) AS avg_standard_attr_id
  FROM base_ports bp
  JOIN status_counts sc ON bp.status = sc.status
  GROUP BY bp.status
),
port_security_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    bp.status,
    bp.network_id,
    bp.id AS port_id,
    COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count
  FROM base_ports bp
  JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON bp.id = psb.port_id
  WHERE bp.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'
  GROUP BY bp.status, bp.network_id, bp.id
),
network_ranges AS (
  SELECT 
    status,
    network_id,
    MAX(binding_count) - MIN(binding_count) AS range_per_network
  FROM port_security_counts
  GROUP BY status, network_id
),
max_network_ranges AS (
  SELECT 
    status,
    MAX(range_per_network) AS max_range_across_networks
  FROM network_ranges
  GROUP BY status
)
SELECT 
  sm.status,
  sm.total_ports,
  sm.min_admin_state_up,
  sm.avg_standard_attr_id,
  mnr.max_range_across_networks
FROM status_measures sm
LEFT JOIN max_network_ranges mnr ON sm.status = mnr.status
ORDER BY sm.total_ports DESC

  SELECT p.id, p.status, p.admin_state_up, p.standard_attr_id, p.network_id, p.tenant_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN ml2_port_bindings mpb ON p.id = mpb.port_id
  WHERE p.device_id = 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7'
    AND mpb.vif_type = 'ovs'
),
status_counts AS (
  SELECT status, COUNT(id) AS total_ports
  FROM base_ports
  GROUP BY status
  ORDER BY total_ports DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
status_measures AS (
  SELECT 
    bp.status,
    COUNT(bp.id) AS total_ports,
    MIN(bp.admin_state_up) AS min_admin_state_up,
    AVG(bp.standard_attr_id) AS avg_standard_attr_id
  FROM base_ports bp
  JOIN status_counts sc ON bp.status = sc.status
  GROUP BY bp.status
),
port_security_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    bp.status,
    bp.network_id,
    bp.id AS port_id,
    COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count
  FROM base_ports bp
  JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON bp.id = psb.port_id
  WHERE bp.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'
  GROUP BY bp.status, bp.network_id, bp.id
),
network_ranges AS (
  SELECT 
    status,
    network_id,
    MAX(binding_count) - MIN(binding_count) AS range_per_network
  FROM port_security_counts
  GROUP BY status, network_id
),
max_network_ranges AS (
  SELECT 
    status,
    MAX(range_per_network) AS max_range_across_networks
  FROM network_ranges
  GROUP BY status
)
SELECT 
  sm.status,
  sm.total_ports,
  sm.min_admin_state_up,
  sm.avg_standard_attr_id,
  mnr.max_range_across_networks
FROM status_measures sm
LEFT JOIN max_network_ranges mnr ON sm.status = mnr.status
ORDER BY sm.total_ports DESC
